sonnet.problem: The joke 'somebody's getting a ribbon, and somebody's getting a polite little nod' says Hezekiah comes out on top when the writer 'lines him up' with the other kings of Judah. That gives away the answer to the very next card (card 11), 'No king of Judah was like Hezekiah'.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The story card counts the siege in years of reign ('fourth year... until Hezekiah's sixth year'). That makes the unit 'years' obvious and rules out 'months' and 'weeks' before card 17 asks 'At the end of three ___'. It also already says when the siege ends.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
